entities.summary: Arne Anders Vilhem Helander was a Finnish architect and Professor of architectural history at Helsinki University of Technology, Espoo, Finland from 1986 until 2005, when he became professor emeritus. In November 2024 he was bestowed with the honorary title of Akateemikko (Academician).
